title: What It Takes: Johnny Cash (3/4)
summaryZh: 強尼・凱許談他如何不放棄夢想，終於得到唱片公司的機會。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — What It Takes

sentences.text: His most famous or infamous commencement exercise speech was, Never, never, never, never, never give up.
sentences.zh: 他那場最有名、或者說最惡名昭彰的畢業典禮演講就是：絕對、絕對、絕對、絕對、絕對不要放棄。

sentences.text: And then somebody else said, Every day in every way I'm getting better and better.
sentences.zh: 後來又有人說：我每一天、在每一方面，都變得越來越好。

sentences.text: I didn't especially believe that about myself, but I said it every day, and I made myself believe it, and it worked.
sentences.zh: 我本來並不特別相信自己真是這樣，但我每天都這樣說，逼自己相信，結果真的有效。
但我從來沒有…我撐下來了。

sentences.text: I never gave up my dream to, quote, sing on the radio.
sentences.zh: 我從來沒有放棄我的夢想，也就是所謂的「在電台上唱歌」。

sentences.text: And that dream came true in 1955. Tell us how that dream came true.
sentences.zh: 那個夢想在1955年實現了。跟我們說說那個夢想是怎麼實現的。

sentences.text: Who gave you your first big break?
sentences.zh: 是誰給了你第一個大好機會？

sentences.text: There was a label called Sun Records in Memphis that was pretty hot with Elvis Presley and two or three locally well-known country acts and some black blues and gospel singers.
sentences.zh: 曼菲斯有一家叫 Sun Records 的唱片公司，當時滿紅的，旗下有貓王，還有兩三組本地小有名氣的鄉村樂團，以及一些黑人藍調和福音歌手。

sentences.text: And when I got out of the Air Force, I went and knocked on that door and was turned away.
sentences.zh: 我從空軍退伍以後，就跑去敲那扇門，結果被拒絕了。

sentences.text: I called back for an interview three or four times, was turned away.
sentences.zh: 我又打了三、四次電話想爭取面談，還是被拒絕。

sentences.text: So one morning, I found out what time the man went to work.
sentences.zh: 所以有一天早上，我打聽到那個人幾點會去上班。

sentences.text: I went down with my guitar and sat on his steps until he got there.
sentences.zh: 我就帶著吉他過去，坐在他門口的台階上等他來。

sentences.text: And when he got there, I introduced myself, and he said, You're the one that's been calling.
sentences.zh: 他到了以後，我自我介紹，他就說：你就是一直打電話來的那個人。
